headline: Maui County Cost of Government Commission Meeting of October 10, 2024

meeting.body: Maui County Cost of Government Commission Meeting of October 10, 2024
meeting.summary: The commission agreed to review County boards and commissions and asked staff to seek guidance on what members may discuss outside public meetings.
meeting.recap: A testifier said Public Works merged four of its boards into one Public Works Commission.[[0:08:55]] A second testifier said a reported problem often goes to only one department, even when several should see it.[[0:21:58]] The commission put off approving its September 18 minutes until a past guest reviews them.[[0:29:13]] The chair said a County Council resolution on Friday's agenda urges the commission to revisit its 2010–2011 review of boards and commissions.[[0:52:05]] Members voted unanimously to let the interim chair tell the Council the commission will take on that work.[[1:03:30]] Members voted unanimously to make a review of County boards and commissions a work item.[[1:05:04]] The commission agreed to set the scope of that review at its next meeting.[[1:06:56]] A commissioner said a West Maui medical facility is not ready for the commission to take up.[[1:09:17]] A mayor's office representative said the mayor recognizes the need for grant writers.[[1:32:15]] A commissioner volunteered to write a summary of the workflow being discussed, for the next meeting.[[1:41:14]]
decided: Approval of the September 18 minutes was put off until a past guest reviews the part about him.
Members approved letting the interim chair respond yes to a County Council resolution asking the commission to look at County boards and commissions.
Members approved making the examination of County boards and commissions a commission work item.
By consensus, members put off setting the scope of the boards and commissions review until the next meeting.
meeting.next: The technical writer agreed to put scoping of the boards and commissions review on the next meeting's agenda. A commissioner plans to gather information on sea level rise and County roadways to bring to the next meeting. The technical writer will send members the list of action items before the draft minutes go out. A commissioner's letter to the Public Works director will be on next month's agenda.
